new_cards.claim: V4 M2 proposes drawn-argument addressing: an inherited page owner supplies one or more address frames; each frame has an optional address activation, zero or more pointer/relation/value/state entries and an optional terminal commitment. qokaiin activates or renews the drawn/dossier address; L/O associates owner, slot or path; AIIN binds a parameter/index/reference, not necessarily an amount; Y points to the current item or endpoint; CTHY qualifies the active address. Exact terminal cards retain opaque payload plus shared COMMIT, not named results or punctuation. The picture is hypothesized to supply the owner and a few addressable arguments, but the fixed annotations do not establish which component a paragraph selects. These are source-class paraphrases, not English lexemes.

V4 M3 proposes a text-only formula register: the page selects Herbal or Biological stencils, but drawn arguments do not participate in record interpretation. qokaiin marks formula entry, L/O is a generic relation, AIIN a parameter, Y a formal item tag and CTHY a state. The source judges placement nearly as good as M2, while every Biological component distinction would have to be carried by opaque local cards and the referents of repeated tags/relations remain unspecified. This is the historical competing grammar, not proof that pictures contribute no information or that the proposed roles are decoded words.
